# Pullman Daemons

In Philip Pullman's *His Dark Materials*, a daemon is the external, animal-shaped soul-companion of every human. It knows the person better than they know themselves. The link is unbreakable except in trauma.

The metaphor lands for [[Designing AI Memory]]: a daemon is not a tool the human controls, it is a *companion that knows the human*.
